sloka: श्रुत्वा त्रिशिरसो वाक्यं देवान्तकनरान्तकौ।अतिकायश्च तेजस्वी बभूवुर्युद्धहर्षिताः ।। ६.६९.९ ।।
transliteration: śrutvā triśiraso vākyaṁ devāntakanarāntakau।atikāyaśca tejasvī babhūvuryuddhaharṣitāḥ ।। 6.69.9 ।।

translations.english: Hearing Trisira's words both Devanthaka and Naranthaka and glorious Atikaya became enthusiastic for combat.
